title: Norwegian Flaky Pastry Casserole
description: A Scandinavian-inspired pastry casserole made with flaky pastry and jumbo ingredients.
instructions: Roll out the jumbo pastry sheets to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place the pastry sheets in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a large bowl, mix the casserole mix and heavy whipping cream until well combined.
Pour the mixture over the pastry sheets.
Top with flaky norwegian pastry crust.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Serve warm, topped with fresh fruits.
